This is the end-to-end film proof half; signature work lives on D1B-signatures. Retain original exact nomination/P/F/foreign-identity/backward-revisit courts; reference readouts use the same exported support, with no unsupported fidelity claims.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

CODE RED D1B ALIGNMENT SEAM. Begins after D1A and D0 and after the frozen nomination-provenance and P/F publication courts. This slice makes the existing aligner consume typed primary projections and retain the proof needed by E0.

Exact paths:
- align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/source.scala
- align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/bridge/StorySourceView.scala

Required result: SourceView no longer assumes canonical text or textLength; each source node carries checked EvidenceSupport plus an explicit primary presentation projection and axis identity. Candidate generation records a complete unforgeable attempt ledger with finite-before-sort outcomes, channel plus stratum rank scope, local lexical receipts, derived anchors and distinct ablation status. HsmmResult retains that checked bundle, full P and F, axis identity, exact source intervals, named external states, Viterbi as summary, support and missingness. AlignWire recursively reconstructs checked costs and receipts, refuses forged or foreign records, and preserves exact evidence traces.

Courts: all text WorkedExample outcomes remain identical; one film source unit maps to two interval alternatives with exact posterior mass; blend, compression, omission, backward revisit, reorder, long jump, typed external excursion and distortion remain distinguishable; row-absent keys, explicit zero-flow foreign endpoints, non-finite likelihood and mismatched flow marginals refuse; channel removal cannot masquerade as provider abstention or Unranked; provider, geometry, source, recall, edition, axis, candidate or cost receipt substitution refuses; display-threshold remainder is retained.

Gate: exact reference-scope command; align and laws JVM, JS and Native tests plus compileAll and scalafmtCheckAll; fixed-seed deterministic P and F; independent numerical oracle for one hand-computable case; mutation courts from both frozen documents; external construction probes and independent type/science review. No codec, output renderer, calibration-default or provider edit.
set.title: [film] D1B migrate SourceView and HsmmResult to movie intervals with full nomination and P F proofs
